title: Freeze the revisioned skill catalog domain contract
objective: Define stable IDs, locators, digests, revisions, visibility states, scopes, snapshots, upserts, and revokes before implementation fans out.
context: Implement the accepted hybrid design: an initial developer-role catalog snapshot, append-only upsert/revoke deltas, on-demand SKILL.md bodies, and an authoritative execution registry.
The repository is a dirty shared worktree. Preserve unrelated changes and modify only owned_files.

source_evidence.note: Codex uses a bounded initial metadata catalog and loads full SKILL.md on demand.
Claude Code supports live skill discovery, visibility overrides, and on-demand skill bodies.
Append-only conversation messages preserve the previously cached prompt prefix.

include: Define SkillID from source plus canonical locator; display names must not be identities.
Define Visibility values auto, name-only, manual-only, and off.
Define a backward-compatible VisibilityOverride record with current visibility and optional last non-off visibility, keyed by stable SkillID and scope.
Define revision-checked project toggle request/result values that can report committed, rejected, or degraded-refresh-required outcomes without claiming false rollback success.
Define immutable EffectiveSkill, CatalogSnapshot, CatalogDelta, CatalogUpsert, and CatalogRevoke values.
Document that revoke blocks future use but cannot erase prompt history.
exclude: Do not modify files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Add the contract types without wiring them into Manager.
Add table tests for validation, JSON round trips, and zero-value behavior.
Document precedence and latest-revision-wins semantics in Go comments.
acceptance_criteria: Bare names are not accepted as stable identities.
An off override can durably remember auto, name-only, or manual-only for a later binary re-enable action.
Mutation contracts carry stable SkillID and observed catalog revision and distinguish conflict from degraded state.
Contracts represent add, update, disable, delete, re-enable, shadowing, and source ownership.
The package tests compile without touching runtime wiring.
risks: An over-broad contract would force downstream tasks to depend on unstable abstractions.
dispatch_prompt: Define and test the revisioned skill catalog value contract in new skills/catalog_contract.go. Do not wire Manager, prompts, commands, or tools.
notes_for_assignee: Keep the diff narrow; if a dependency contract is insufficient, report the required change to the integrator instead of editing another task's files.
